items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: he actually went to New York and met Robert Moog himself to learn.

ctx.x: Yeah he created it. And of course Universal owns those, so they get royalties from that kind of stuff too. But he had a Moog synthesizer and he actually went to New York and met Robert Moog himself to learn. And back in those days everything was monophonic. So you’ve got phase shifters and you’ve got sine and sawtooth waves and you’ve got — so he was making those telephone patch chords. And he’d make them himself so he could plug one into the other. He bought an Ampex 8-track tape recorder in the 60s. That thing…
